messages:
elena_sales: Hey team -- AegisFin wants a short POC next week. They asked for a dedicated GPU pool in eu-west1, H100s if possible, ~8 GPUs total, 2-week window. Need advice on lead time, SKU mix, and any VPC/KMS notes. cc @kai_infra @morgan_se

kai_infra: @elena_sales sounds doable but H100 capacity in eu-west1 is tight next week. Do we know expected concurrency / tokens/sec? that determines whether 8 H100s is enough or we should suggest more smaller instances. also: do they need private VPC peering or just IP allowlist?

elena_sales: They said approx 40 concurrent requests at peak, average seq len ~1024 tokens, model is an instruction-tuned LlamaX-70B variant (fp16). Private VPC & customer-managed KMS required. Billing: they expect short-term usage billing (no long-term commit).

morgan_se: For 40 concurrent with 1024, 8x H100 might be borderline depending on batching. Suggest two options to propose: (A) 8x H100 dedicated with aggressive batching + KV cache (good perf, higher cost) (B) 12x A100-80GB mixed with H100 fallback (lower immediate capacity but cheaper). We should give estimated throughput and tail latency.

\kana_security: Need security checklist: confirm VPC peering vs Private deployment. If it's VPC peering we need their CIDR, expected egress rules, and KMS ARN for key wrap. Also add that we'll need an approved ATO questionnaire for keys in EU region.

provision-bot: Provision template v2 available. Quick JSON for ops intake below — fill the placeholders and paste back:

```json
{
  "customer": "AegisFin",
  "env": "poc",
  "region": "eu-west1",
  "requested_sku": "H100:8",
  "alternate_sku": "A100-80GB:12",
  "duration_days": "14",
  "workload": {
    "concurrency": "40",
    "avg_seq_len": "1024",
    "model": "LlamaX-70B-ft-instruct"
  },
  "network": {
    "vpc_option": "peering",
    "customer_cidr": "<CIDR>",
    "allowed_ips": ["<ip list>"],
    "kms_required": "true",
    "kms_arn": "<kms-arn>"
  },
  "billing": {
    "term": "short-term",
    "payment_method": "invoice"
  }
}
```

kai_infra: If you paste that filled, I can trigger capacity check. Note lead time: if we lock H100s in eu-west1 it's a 72hr allocation window in our system; if we need 8 immediately it may push to next-day depending on other commitments. Also if they need KMS in customer's account, we need cross-account role - that adds ~1-2 days for IAM setup.

morgan_se: I'll draft the proposal text for both SKU options with expected p95 latencies and cost delta. Quick back-of-envelope: option A p95 ~1200-1600ms, option B p95 ~1500-2200ms depending on model kernel compatibility. Will confirm after perf sim.

elena_sales: Thanks. I'll ask the AE to collect CIDR and KMS ARN. Also flagging to AegisFin: if they can accept a 48hr start window, H100 is likely.

ana_security: Also remind customer we need data residency confirmation and processing agreement for EU keys.

provision-bot: Intake received: please paste the completed JSON into this thread and add approval from security (ana_security) to proceed. Once approved, ops will create the dedicated pool and share API creds. :rocket:
